main_text.p: يوم من شهر حرام افضل من صوم ثلاثين من غيره وصوم يوم من شهر رمضان افضل من صوم ثلثين من شهر حرام Dies è menfe facro unus [jejunio dicatur] praftat jejunio triginta dierum [?] alius menfis, at dies unus menfis Ramadan praftat jejunio triginta dierum menfis facri. Inter dies autem commendatiores cenfetur عاشورا Ashura, i.e. decimus dies menfis Mobarram, qui etiam Arabibus ante Mohammedem, jejunio facer, referente AlBarezio in suis ad sermones Ebn Nobata commentariis, scil. Ayesham dixisse, ان قريشا Koraishitas solitos jejunare, ante religionem à Mohammede conditam, die Ashura, at AlKazwinius Mohammedem, ejus jejunio dicandi occasionem, à Judaeis accepisse tradit, روي ان رسول الله لما قدم المدينة وجد يهودهما يصومون عاشورا فسألهم عن ذلك فقالوا انه النبي غرق فيه فرعون وقومه و نجي موسى ومن معه فقال انا احق بموسى منهم فامر بصوم عاشورا Fertur Mohammedem cùm Medinam pervenissiet, atque ibi Judaeos die Ashura jejunantes reperisset, rogâsse ipsos quare hoc facerent, qui dixerunt, quoniam hoc die submersus esset Pharaoh cum populo suo, Mose, cum iis qui cum ipso erant, evadente. Tam ille, Plus mihi cum Mose est quàm illis, praecepitque ut die Ashura jejunarent. Quod tamen postea ipsi displicuisse videtur, quòd Judaeos imitatus fuerit, ideoque dixisse, se, modo alterum annum viveret, die nono jejunaturum, كراهة موافقة

page.notes: The Arabic lines are copied letter by letter from a low-resolution scan. The vowel marks and some letters near the lines' ends are uncertain and may differ from the print. The Arabic on the line with "روي" and the word "نجي" are uncertain. The Latin "Iuijufvis" is read as "Lujusvis" with a blot over the first letters, and "dierum" on the first line is partly obscured. A dark blot sits on the "Dies" line and is not printed text. The Latin "cùm" and "quàm" are as printed. The line ending "die nono jejunaturum," is followed by the Arabic word on the final line, which is copied as one unit. No marginal notes or catchword are printed.
